caption:
Global Metadata
Basic Attributes: bpm is 84. key is D major. Warm minimal ambient underscore for a calm technical explainer.
Global Emotional Progression: Focused and quietly optimistic from start to finish, a steady even mood with a soft settle at the end.
Sonics & Production Profile: Even and unobtrusive. Wide gentle stereo field, soft low end, no harsh transients. Dynamics stay flat so nothing pokes through a voiceover.
Vocal Details
Vocal Gender & Timbre: Instrumental. Felt piano and electric piano.
Arrangement
Instrument Lifecycle Description: Soft felt piano single notes with long decay over warm electric piano chords, a light round synth bass holding the root, sparse glassy plucks every few bars.
Groove & Foundation Progression: The pulse comes only from the piano and the sustained chords.
